content: .{@-वर्गः@} .²1 an aggregate of five. .²2 the five essential elements of the body. .²3 the five organs of sense; संतुष्टपञ्चवर्गोऽहं लोकयात्रां प्रवाहये <ls>Rām. 2. 109. 27</ls>. .²4 the five daily sacrifices enjoined to be performed by a Brāhmaṇa; <ab>cf.</ab> महायज्ञ. .²5 the five classes of spies (कापटिक, उदास्थित, गृहपतिव्यञ्जन, वैदेहिकव्यञ्जन and तापसव्यञ्जन); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 7. 154</ls>.
